illustration.alt: The companion sitting on a cushion next to an open book with a volcano drawn on the cover.

companionLines.bo: Hi {nome}! There's a volcano. Will you hold my hand?
companionLines.pilu: Hi {nome}! Did you see? Lia built a very tall tower.
companionLines.tango: Hi {nome}! Come on, let's look right now! ...Wait. First we sit down.

illustration.alt: Lia proudly looks at a colourful tower of blocks with a little flag on top.

screens.text: Lia builds a tall, tall tower. A red block, a blue one, a yellow one. On top, the little flag.

illustration.alt: Teo, her little brother, touches the bottom block; the tower falls and the blocks fly across the floor.

screens.text: Here comes Teo, her little brother. He touches the bottom block. CRASH! The whole tower falls.

illustration.alt: Lia with a red face and clenched fists; behind her, see-through, a smoking volcano.

screens.text: Lia feels something hot in her tummy. Her hands close by themselves. Her face turns red. Lia is angry.

companionLines.bo: I feel it in my ears. Where do you feel it?
companionLines.pilu: Look at Lia's hands. They're shut tight.
companionLines.tango: I know that one! My paws close just like that!

illustration.alt: On the table, three faces drawn on cards: an angry one, a sad one, a happy one. Grandma and Lia sit close together.

screens.text: Grandma sits down next to Lia. She draws three faces on three cards.

companionLines.bo: Let's look at the faces together, slowly.
companionLines.pilu: One face at a time. Look carefully.
companionLines.tango: Three faces! Come on! ...Wait. One at a time.

lesson.together: Point to one face at a time and just say: "This face is angry". Then ask: "Where is the sad face?". At the end, point to one and ask: "How does this face feel?". If they touch a different face, tell them that face's name, nothing more.
lesson.ask: And this face, how does it feel?
lesson.done: Angry, sad, happy. Every face is allowed.

illustration.alt: Lia and Grandma with their hands on their tummies; above them the volcano turns orange and the lava flows down slowly.

screens.text: Grandma says: "It's okay to be angry. Let's do the volcano breath." Hands on your tummy. In: one, two, three. Out: shhhh.

companionLines.bo: Let's do it too. In, one, two, three. Out, shhhh.
companionLines.pilu: Hands on your tummy. Can you feel it go up and down?
companionLines.tango: In, one, two, three! Out... shhhh. Slowly, slowly.

illustration.alt: Lia and Teo build a low, wide tower together; in the background the volcano is green, with a flower on top.

screens.text: The volcano goes down slowly, slowly. Lia and Teo build a new tower, wide, wide.

companionLines.bo: My volcano is calm now, {nome}. See you tomorrow!
companionLines.pilu: Tonight I'll try the volcano breath, {nome}. See you tomorrow.
companionLines.tango: Tomorrow I'll breathe before I run, {nome}. See you tomorrow!
